blocks.text:
An element with position: sticky; toggles between
a relative and fixed
position, depending on the scroll position.

A sticky element is positioned relative until a certain scroll position is
reached - then it "sticks" in that place (like position:fixed).

You must specify at least one of the top, right, bottom or left
properties, for
sticky positioning to work.

In this example, when the sticky element reach the top of the page
(top: 0), it sticks to this position:

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: Sticky positioning is commonly used for:

items: Sticky headers - Navigation bars that stick to the top when scrolling
Sticky sidebars - Side content that stays visible while scrolling main content
Sticky table headers - Table headers that remain visible when scrolling long tables
